answer_1.quote: We have presented a dataset CS2W, which is the first open‑source Chinese spoken‑to‑written conversion dataset... We conducted benchmark evaluation experiments on CS2W to evaluate the performance of cutting‑edge large language models (LLMs) on Chinese spoken‑to‑written style conversion... To assess the impact of spoken‑to‑written language conversion on downstream tasks, we employed Chinese‑to‑English machine translation as a representative task.
answer_1.outputs: written‑style normalized Chinese sentences (and downstream MT translations)

answer_2.quote: We evaluated models with BLEU and ROUGE-L. Referring to most grammatical error correction tasks, we also used the word‑based MaxMatch scorer to calculate P/R/F values.

answer_4.quote: The results from human evaluation are based on the accuracy of the first round of annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assessed whether the corrected written sentence was accurate with respect to the original spoken sentence according to the annotation guidelines.
